intro: Most of what the Bible says about relationships applies to every kind: family, friendship, marriage, church and work. These passages describe the love, patience and forgiveness it asks for. They are about how to love, and they are not a reason to stay where you are not safe.

passages.reason: Jesus gives his followers one measure for love: “Just as I have loved you, you also love one another”.
Paul describes love by what it does and does not do, beginning with “Love is patient and is kind”.
A list of what to wear in life with others: compassion, kindness, humility and perseverance, and forgiveness “even as Christ forgave you”.
Paul is realistic about conflict: “If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men”.
Peter asks how often he must forgive, and Jesus answers “until seventy times seven”.
